verdict.rationale: First-party docs say search results and citations appear in the chat when ChatGPT uses web search. ChatGPT can also search the web, browse sites, gather current information, compare sources and summarize findings, and the CLI can fetch live results with `--search`. Community users confirm the web search feature shipped and works, though one reports a wrong current-weather answer and another rates it below Perplexity, which questions accuracy but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how citations are presented and linked, and independent corroboration that the citations reliably point back to the sources.
